title: The fastest savings stop losses already occurring
subtitle: WattZap Guard — one protection layer around the electricity bill
a11yLabel: The WattZap Guard protection layer: PF Guard, Demand Guard, Bill Guard and Solar Guard working as one system around the bill.

cards.heading: PF Guard
bullets: Identifies power-factor penalties and their causes

cards.heading: Demand Guard
bullets: Flags spike patterns and what they cost
Controls demand charges before they recur

cards.heading: Bill Guard
bullets: Checks every bill for anomalies and errors
Supports recovery where money is owed

cards.heading: Solar Guard
bullets: Verifies solar delivers what was promised

content.note: Protection comes before expansion — the four Guards work as one layer, not separate products.
